findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: get_company_profile, get_pricing, search, fetch · Private data: get_company_summary, get_public_obligations, get_exchange_rate, get_company_profile, get_company_context, get_company_deadlines, get_company_obligations, get_public_deadlines, explain_compliance_error, search_companies, get_company_verification, get_company_authority, get_company_accounts, get_company_evidence_pack, get_company_history, list_changes, get_altinn_migration_guidance, get_pricing, get_credit_balance, redeem_issuance_token, search, fetch · Public sink: get_company_profile · Destructive: search_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile, get_pricing, search, fetch · Private data: get_company_summary, get_public_obligations, get_exchange_rate, get_company_profile, get_company_context, get_company_deadlines, get_company_obligations, get_public_deadlines, explain_compliance_error, search_companies, get_company_verification, get_company_authority, get_company_accounts, get_company_evidence_pack, get_company_history, list_changes, get_altinn_migration_guidance, get_pricing, get_credit_balance, redeem_issuance_token, search, fetch · Public sink: get_company_profile · Destructive: search_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
